name: PCHI motion (generic)
hint: a program name (letters, digits, _ . -, up to 64)

rules.source: PCHI's own generic message: for the twin and for a bridge written to receive it. Not any vendor's

notes: A stand-in for the real thing: PCHI's own OSC messages for 'run this named program', 'pause' and 'stop'. Used with the twin and with a bridge that turns them into a robot's own commands. STOP MOTION sends /pchi/motion/stop. It is a software request, not an emergency stop: it depends on the network and on the receiver being alive.
